liveGroups.group: 0-install-gate (CLI only, app closed, under lock.sh; ~15 min)

checks.steps:
With VLC Redesign closed:
1. Run codesign --verify --deep --strict '/Applications/VLC Redesign.app'.
2. Compare the mtime of Contents/Frameworks/plugins/plugins.dat with every *.dylib under plugins.
3. Run otool -L Contents/Frameworks/plugins/libmacosx_redesign_plugin.dylib | grep -i accelerate.
4. Run stat -f %m /Applications/VLC.app.
5. Run ls /Applications | grep -i vlc.
6. Run find ../build/codex-arm64 -maxdepth 3 -name '*.app'.
checks.expect:
- The signature is valid.
- plugins.dat is newer than every plugin.
- Accelerate.framework is listed.
- VLC.app's mtime is still 1743527633.
- /Applications holds only VLC.app and VLC Redesign.app.
- The build dir has no leftover .app.
- The plugin dylib is dated Oct 17 03:24 or later (the wave build).

checks.steps:
Under lock.sh, with SDKROOT exported and the app closed, run:
make -C ../build/codex-arm64/modules check-macosx-redesign-app MXR_SMOKE_MEDIA='"../build/media/Test Show S01E01.mp4" "../build/media/Test Show S01E03.mp4"'
Then grep modules/macosx-redesign-smoke.log.
checks.expect:
- Exit 0 and PASS.
- The log shows the macosx_redesign intf and vout, videotoolbox, auhal, the .srt subtitles loaded and a first picture for each item.
- The exit is clean, with 0 'stale plugins cache' lines.

checks.steps: Back up the redesign's vlcrc and ml.db (under ~/Library/Application Support/<bundle id> and ~/Library/Preferences) into ../build/evidence/final5/backup. Then open /Applications/VLC Redesign.app from Finder.
checks.expect:
- No Gatekeeper or 'damaged' prompt.
- The redesign interface starts with its own icon.
- Console has no plugins.dat signature or cache warnings.
Every later group restores vlcrc and ml.db from this backup when it finishes.

checks.steps:
After the wave commit, with no agents editing, run under the lock:
make -C ../build/codex-arm64 -j8
Run it twice, and record the mtimes of libMXRPlugin.a, libmacosx_redesign_plugin.dylib and its .la after each run.
checks.expect: The second make leaves all three mtimes unchanged.

checks.steps: Play Test Show S01E01.mp4 in a window at the largest size (1728×1001 pt; a 1920×1080 window is not possible on this display), then pause. Capture the window with screencapture -l and scan the rows and columns of the top 50 pt.
checks.expect:
- There is a single 40 pt top bar with no second title strip.
- The traffic lights are vertically centred in it, and the VLC cone sits right after them.
- The rest matches S01.Window/shipping and Player-6 apart from the D022 differences. This build hides the toolbar in fullscreen and draws new canvas bands, so it is re-checked here.

checks.steps:
1. Play S01E01 and enter fullscreen with the top-bar button.
2. Wait 5 s for the bars to hide.
3. Move the pointer to y=0 and hold it there 1 s.
4. Move it slowly down below the menu bar and the titlebar strip, hover ⋯ and click it.
5. Let the bars hide, then reveal the top again.
6. Repeat on an external display if one is connected.
checks.expect:
- The macOS menu bar and a titlebar strip with only the traffic lights appear, with no empty 40 pt toolbar band.
- At the same time the app's top bar (cone, ⋯, sidebar toggle, chip, title, exit-fullscreen) appears directly below the strip.
- When the strip slides away, the top bar stays reachable and ⋯ opens its menu.
- The video never moves.
- The next reveal works again. This was a FAIL in live run 1.

checks.steps: In fullscreen, move the pointer near the bottom edge, then away, then near the top edge, then into the middle.
checks.expect:
- Near the bottom only the control bar appears; near the top only the top bar (with the strip).
- Each bar hides right after the pointer leaves its zone.
- The video does not jump, and there is no frame in fullscreen (VIDEO_BREAKDOWN §03 MUST).

checks.steps: In fullscreen while playing, keep the mouse still for the auto-hide delay, then make a small move in the middle of the screen.
checks.expect: The cursor and bars hide after the delay. A small move brings the cursor back, and the bars stay hidden (D023).

checks.steps: Leave fullscreen. In the window, hover the fullscreen button until its tooltip shows, click it, then keep the mouse still for 5 s.
checks.expect: No 'Fullscreen' tooltip stays on screen after the bars auto-hide.

checks.steps: Leave fullscreen with the exit-fullscreen button and capture the top 40 pt of the window.
checks.expect: There is again one 40 pt top bar, with the traffic lights centred and the cone right after them (the toolbar is restored, C3 holds).

checks.steps:
(a) Play S01E01 (60 s), enter fullscreen and let it reach the end.
(b) With nothing playing, enter fullscreen on the library or empty window, then open S01E01 and let it end.
checks.expect:
(a) The window leaves fullscreen at the end, as VLC does.
(b) The window stays fullscreen.

checks.steps: Play S01E01 and open the queue. Capture the window. Press ⌘\, capture, press ⌘\ again and capture.
checks.expect:
- The queue floats over the right of the video.
- With Hide UI on, there are no bars, only the 10 pt frame (S06).
- After Hide UI is turned off, the queue is open again.

checks.steps: While S01E01 plays, open the settings sidebar (gear) and compare the video rect with a capture taken just before.
checks.expect: The sidebar overlays the video. The video's left edge, size and position do not change.

checks.steps: While playing, choose Video ▸ Picture in Picture. Click the placeholder in the main window. Start PiP again and close the PiP window with its X.
checks.expect:
- The video moves into native PiP, and the main window shows the PiP glyph with 'This video is playing in Picture in Picture'.
- Clicking the placeholder or closing PiP brings the video back. A pause on close is AVKit behaviour.
- The PlayerView canvas changed in this wave, so this is re-checked.

2. Play S01E01 (16:9) at the default window size.
3. Measure the picture rect with the compact library closed (⌘L), then with it open.
4. Switch to Dark and measure again.
5. In Light, wait for a subtitle cue.
checks.expect:
- The picture width and position are identical in all three measurements; the library no longer rescales or aspect-fills the video.
- The subtitle sits above the control bar and is not cut.
- This was the major extra finding of live run 1.

checks.steps:

summary:
This wave is code-complete and green offscreen, but the end product is still unproven in the real window. All 10 areas passed verification. The integration run was clean:
- Swift tests: 505/505.
- Native suites: all pass, with audio passing 10 of 10 runs.
- Install: done.
- Engine diff: empty.
- Snapshot check: 21 PASS, 64 REVIEW, 31 FAIL, up from 15/49/43.

The installed build matches the working tree; the only source file newer than it is the gallery-only AppGallery.swift.

**What still blocks a final product (P0):**
- **Nothing is committed.** 85 paths are uncommitted on top of the WIP commit 3c690eb2a0.
- **Almost no live acceptance has run.** Only group 1-window ever ran, on the old build. The other 8 groups ended 'agent failed'. The two live FAILs (fullscreen top edge, Light bars and rescale) and the NOT-RUN resume toast are fixed, but only offscreen. The fullscreen-edge fix (D055) depends on AppKit notifications that cannot be proven offscreen.

**Open product defects (P1):**
- **Light dialogs:** in the Light theme, secondary buttons (Choose…, Cancel) are invisible in every standard dialog. Their tile has the same colour as the opaque dialog surface (DialogSupport.swift:85). This was handed over and nobody fixed it.
- **Narrow window:** with a right panel open, the compact library is not clamped to its minimum width (MXRAppView.swift:284). At 480 pt it gets 153 pt against the 208 pt minimum, so its header overflows.
- **Owner sign-off:** the decisions needing the owner have grown to D042, D044 and D046–D055, plus the D007, D028, D032, D039 and D044 amendments and the D030 defaults. Three of them accept something that could be fixed: the truncated 'Continue Watchi…' label (D051), subtitles hidden under the compact library (D055), and the audio-track rows left disabled (D039).
- **HANDOFF.md** is a day out of date.

**Smaller items (P2):**
- Colour differences of 2–3 levels with no decision: the full-library top bar, the music control bar, the volume cone gradient and the S64 Save button.
- The Settings toggle is missing Figma's 3 pt gap on every page.
- Filter sliders draw end ticks that Figma does not, and the delay-slider fill ends 4 pt short.
- The S08 gallery submenu sits 48 pt too high (fixture only).
- Bridge edge cases: the jump OSD can show the wrong time after a chapter key, and the subtitle safe inset is not re-sent when the display scale changes.
- Hygiene: a literal 0.4 opacity, a stale comment, and native-tests.py skipping the plugin-cache step without a warning.
- Audit items nobody owns: PER-02 and CODE-06. CODE-02 and the MXRServicesBridge.m split (B-15) have no schedule.

**The live checklist** has 12 groups, each about 15–30 minutes, built from:
- the unrun groups 2–9 of the previous wave;
- the FAIL, NOT-RUN and extra findings of group 1;
- group 1's PASS checks only where this wave changed the code behind them (C3, C5, cursor, PiP, queue with Hide UI, CPU);
- every live check from this wave, deduplicated: the A-window, B-controls and H-design lists were repeated up to 4 times;
- the owner's complaints C1–C7, marked ownerComplaint.

Notes for the checklist:
- **Screen size:** the display is 1728×1117 pt, so the largest window is 1728×1001 instead of 1920×1080.
- **Test media:** resume checks, long seeks and the live stream use the 10 min S01E03. The stream is served locally with `vlc -I dummy --sout`. A song file is extracted from S01E03 with ffmpeg. The H-design solid clips (#2D2D2D, red) are used for colour sampling.
- **Owner data:** group 0 backs up vlcrc and ml.db, and every group restores them and removes test playlists.
- **Expected FAILs:** two checks are expected to fail until their fixes land: Light dialog buttons, and the narrow window with a right panel.
- **Hardware and downloads:** the hardware checks (Audio CD, camera, Chromecast) and the Lua extension check are NOT-RUN unless the hardware or an extension is already present. Nothing is downloaded without the owner's approval.

Nothing was written to ../build/evidence/final4/critic/; this was a read-only pass.
